label: 소박한 일상을 그대로 보여 줍니다
label_en: Show your plain daily life as it is
success_text: 방영 후 "생각보다 멋있다"는 댓글이 조용히 늘어납니다.
success_text_en: After it airs, quiet comments saying "cooler than expected" begin to pile up.

label: 감독에게 출연료를 두둑이 요구합니다
label_en: Demand a hefty appearance fee
success_text: 감독이 투덜대며 돈을 내지만 영상은 밋밋하게 나옵니다.
success_text_en: The director grumbles and pays, but the film comes out bland.
fail_text_en: The director adds a narration calling you "hypocrites after all."

label: 이름 없이 복구를 계속합니다
label_en: Keep rebuilding without taking credit
success_text: 생존자들이 당신의 문 앞에 꽃을 놓고 갑니다.
success_text_en: Survivors leave flowers at your door.

label: 구조 사진을 퍼뜨리게 합니다
label_en: Spread photos of the rescue
success_text_en: The photos spread, and people murmur that "the fools were right."
fail_text_en: You're accused of exploiting the disaster.

label: 담담히 침묵을 지킵니다
label_en: Keep a calm silence
success_text_en: Your silence is read as dignity.

label: 공개적으로 그들을 꾸짖습니다
label_en: Publicly rebuke them
success_text: 광장의 군중이 처음으로 당신 편에 섭니다.
success_text_en: For the first time, the crowd in the square stands with you.

label: 빈 자리를 노려 그들의 고객을 가로챕니다
label_en: Poach their clients in the chaos
success_text_en: Money flows in, but your followers give you strange looks.

label: 아이 가족에게 감사 편지를 보냅니다
label_en: Send the child's family a thank-you letter
success_text: 편지마저 화제가 되어 훈훈한 소문이 번집니다.
success_text_en: Even the letter becomes news, and a warm rumor spreads.

label: 아이를 교단 홍보대사로 세웁니다
label_en: Make the child your cult's ambassador
success_text_en: The parents agree and your event hall is packed.
fail_text_en: You're condemned for "even using a child."

label: 가수를 조용히 계속 돌봅니다
label_en: Keep quietly caring for the singer
success_text: 가수의 팬들 사이에서 당신의 평이 바뀝니다.
success_text_en: Opinions of you shift among the singer's fans.

label: 가수와 함께 절제 공연을 엽니다
label_en: Hold a temperance concert with the singer
success_text_en: Surprisingly, tickets sell out and the audience falls solemn.
fail_text_en: The audience dozes off and leaves.

label: 무료로 약초탕을 나눕니다
label_en: Hand out the broth for free
success_text: 병이 잦아든 뒤 사람들이 당신의 이름을 부릅니다.
success_text_en: When the sickness subsides, people call your name.

label: 최소한의 값만 받습니다
label_en: Charge only a minimal price
success_text_en: People nod at the fair price.

label: 약초탕 값을 열 배로 올립니다
label_en: Raise the broth price tenfold
success_text_en: The vault fills, but you hear "you're no different."

label: 칼럼니스트를 초대해 차를 대접합니다
label_en: Invite the columnist for tea
success_text: 두 번째 칼럼은 더 다정한 어조로 실립니다.
success_text_en: The second column runs in a warmer tone.

label: 인내에 대한 공개 강연을 엽니다
label_en: Hold a public lecture on patience
success_text_en: The audience stays to the very end.
fail_text_en: The lecture is cut short amid boos.

label: 그를 다시 반갑게 맞이합니다
label_en: Welcome them back warmly
success_text: 돌아온 그의 이야기에 신도들이 고개를 듭니다.
success_text_en: Your followers lift their heads at their story.

label: 판결문을 교단 벽에 내겁니다
label_en: Post the verdict on the temple wall
success_text_en: Passersby stop to read it.

label: 소박한 대접을 이어 갑니다
label_en: Continue your simple hospitality
success_text: 사교계에 "그 집 수프가 그립다"는 말이 돕니다.
success_text_en: Word in high society is, "I miss that house's soup."

label: 그녀의 인맥으로 후원자를 모읍니다
label_en: Gather patrons through her connections
success_text_en: A few doubtful patrons open their purses.
fail_text_en: People say "it was about money after all."

label: 웃으며 상을 받으러 갑니다
label_en: Go accept the award with a smile
success_text_en: Your humble speech spreads as a meme.

label: 상을 거절하고 봉사를 나갑니다
label_en: Decline and go volunteer instead
success_text_en: "A real fool" is said with affection now.

label: 굿즈를 만들어 팝니다
label_en: Make and sell merchandise
success_text: 굿즈는 팔리지만 응원 댓글이 조금 식습니다.
success_text_en: The merch sells, but the supportive comments cool a bit.

label: 향유 목욕과 깊은 잠을 즐깁니다
label_en: Indulge in a perfumed bath and deep sleep
success_text: 따뜻한 향기 속에서 감각이 천천히 돌아옵니다.
success_text_en: In the warm fragrance, your senses slowly return.

label: 더 센 자극으로 버팁니다
label_en: Push through with stronger thrills
success_text_en: The flame flares up again for a moment.
fail_text_en: Your body gives out first and you're bedridden for three days.

label: 온천 휴양지로 단체 여행을 보냅니다
label_en: Send them on a group hot-spring retreat
success_text_en: Your followers return with color in their cheeks.

label: 연회를 멈추고 금식일을 선포합니다
label_en: Halt the feasts and declare a fast day
success_text_en: Your followers are puzzled but oddly refreshed.

label: 코스를 천천히 음미합니다
label_en: Savor the courses slowly
success_text_en: Each dish brings back a forgotten joy.

label: 후원자에게 답례 연회를 크게 엽니다
label_en: Throw a lavish return banquet for the patron
success_text_en: Moved, the patron promises further support.
fail_text: 답례 연회가 소란으로 끝나 머리만 아픕니다.
fail_text_en: The return banquet ends in chaos and only leaves you a headache.

label: 치유사의 향 요법을 받습니다
label_en: Receive the healer's incense therapy
success_text: 몽롱한 향 속에서 오래 잠긴 피로가 풀립니다.
success_text_en: In the hazy incense, long-buried fatigue melts away.
fail_text_en: The incense is too strong and you're dizzy all day.

label: 돌려보내고 산책을 시작합니다
label_en: Send them away and start taking walks
success_text_en: Your walks grow a little longer each day.

label: 개인 휴양 별장을 내어 줍니다
label_en: Offer them a private retreat villa
success_text_en: The followers resting at the villa send letters of thanks.

label: 마사지 장인을 불러 모두를 돌봅니다
label_en: Bring in a master masseur for everyone
success_text_en: Stiff shoulders loosen and laughter returns.

label: 떠나게 내버려 둡니다
label_en: Let them go
success_text: 남은 신도들은 더 단단히 당신 곁에 섭니다.
success_text_en: Those who remain stand more firmly by your side.

label: 한 달 내내 늘어지게 쉽니다
label_en: Lounge lazily the entire month
success_text: 돌아오니 몸은 가볍지만 측근들이 자리를 넘보고 있습니다.
success_text_en: You return refreshed, but your aides have been eyeing your seat.

label: 일주일만 쉬고 돌아옵니다
label_en: Rest a week and come back
success_text_en: A short but rich rest warms your heart.

label: 후원자의 속셈을 의심해 거절합니다
label_en: Refuse, suspecting the patron's motives
success_text_en: The patron is disappointed, but you owe nothing.

label: 돈을 내고 편히 즐깁니다
label_en: Pay up and enjoy it with ease
success_text_en: For once, everyone enjoys the festival like guests.

label: 값을 깎아 절반만 맡깁니다
label_en: Haggle and outsource only half
success_text_en: A decent festival is decently fun.
fail_text_en: The half-baked festival disappoints your followers.

label: 고향 요리를 기꺼이 받습니다
label_en: Gladly accept the home cooking
success_text: 소박한 국물 한 숟가락에 눈물이 핑 돕니다.
success_text_en: A spoonful of humble broth brings tears to your eyes.

label: 요리장에게 휴가와 상여금을 줍니다
label_en: Give the cook a holiday and a bonus
success_text_en: The cook's gratitude spreads throughout the kitchen.

label: 침구를 받고 "쉼의 밤"을 선포합니다
label_en: Accept and declare a "Night of Rest"
success_text: 비단 이불 속에서 교단 전체가 늦잠을 잡니다.
success_text_en: The whole cult sleeps in beneath silk covers.

label: 기부의 대가를 묻습니다
label_en: Ask what the donation costs
success_text: 귀족이 웃으며 "그저 초대만 해 주시오"라 답합니다.
success_text_en: The noble laughs and says, "Just invite me sometime."
fail_text_en: Offended, the noble takes the bedding back.

label: 한동안 모든 쾌락을 내려놓습니다
label_en: Set aside all pleasures for a while
success_text: 고요 끝에 다시 피어나는 갈망이 달콤합니다.
success_text_en: After the stillness, the longing that blooms again is sweet.

label: 노파를 연회에 초대해 대접합니다
label_en: Invite the old woman to a feast
success_text_en: The old woman dances and blesses your fortune.

label: 미신이라며 쫓아냅니다
label_en: Chase her off as superstition
success_text: 노파는 웃으며 사라지고 묘한 공허가 남습니다.
success_text_en: She vanishes laughing, leaving a strange emptiness.
